_comment: Mod benchmark manifest. 'mods' keys are mods.vintagestory.at URL aliases (the slug in https://mods.vintagestory.at/<slug>). Optional per mod: version (exact modversion to pin), deps (library mods loaded with it but not benchmarked alone), label, file (local zip instead of download). 'variants' is optional: without it you get baseline + one variant per non-library mod + 'all'.
